summary: Learn to assess, design, and govern AI agents for business with practical frameworks, templates, and executive-ready outputs.
lede: Agentic AI and AI agents use language models, tool access and feedback loops to carry out bounded business tasks. For leaders and professionals evaluating or sponsoring automation, this primer explains how to screen use cases, map workflows, and set controls for data access, output checks, and human approval before planning a rollout.
audienceIntro: This AI agents for business course is designed for professionals who need to evaluate, govern, or sponsor agentic automation in real business settings.
prerequisites: Participants should have working familiarity with business process documentation, digital collaboration tools, and executive decision-making workflows. No programming is required, but prior exposure to AI tools such as Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar LLM-based assistants will help you move faster. This is an intermediate course, so you should be ready to evaluate use cases, discuss risk, and work with structured templates for governance and rollout planning. Participants should bring a laptop and, where possible, examples of business processes, policy constraints, or automation candidates from their own function.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
